scope: Story-dependent duck appearances for the existing 27 Bible Journey chapters; 11 new strips and 3 reused selection strips.

normalization.kind: mechanical crop, uniform per-strip resize and transparent padding

sharedAnchor.meaning: Feet for walking stages; basket bottom for the floating infant. Runtime adds gentle basket bobbing.

normalization.scaleMethod: For each strip, split into four equal cells, crop each to bounds detected at alpha > 8, measure maximum content width/height, and use min(targetWidth/maxWidth,targetHeight/maxHeight) for all four frames. Round resized dimensions and center each frame at the shared baseline.
normalization.alphaHandling: Preserve the sampled RGBA inside retained content; no background replacement, opacity thresholding, painting, recoloring or redrawing. Alpha threshold is used only to detect crop bounds.
